input.quote: Client will pay TrueLink's fees for requested Hosting Services and Support Services pursuant to the schedule of charges set forth on Exhibits "A" and "B" attached hereto, (but not less than $____ per month for the Hosting Services and $____ per month for Support Services).
input.rationale: There is a minimum commitment on us: Section 5(a) sets a monthly floor ("not less than $____ per month") for Hosting and Support Services, and Section 6 makes those minimum monthly fees non-contestable. However, the commitment sits at the playbook fallback rather than in walk-away territory: (i) exposure is confined to the current 12-month term, since Section 13 runs for one year and renews in one-year increments subject to 30 days' notice of non-renewal by either party; (ii) Section 14 gives us a stand-alone right to terminate at any time on written notice, with services (and therefore the minimum) ending the last day of the month following notice — roughly a 30-60 day exit; and (iii) there is no shortfall payment, penalty or accelerated-balance mechanic anywhere in the document, so we pay only monthly minimums for months actually served. Section 2(a) also confirms we are "not obligated to utilize the License" and may source equivalent services elsewhere, so there is no volume cap or exclusivity backing the floor. Two drafting points to note but not redline: the dollar amounts and the Section 4 support period are left blank and should be completed before signature, and Section 6's reference to "the minimum monthly fees listed in Section 4" is a mis-cross-reference (the minimums are in Section 5(a)); Section 14's "Subject to Section 4" should likewise be confirmed as preserving TrueLink's support-availability period rather than qualifying our termination right.
